compiled_state.title: Create hash-pinned requirements.lock and CI lint script for loose-pin rejection
compiled_state.author: Test
compiled_state.description:
## Testing Mode
GREEN

## Story DD Coverage
DD2: LiteLLM + all transitive deps exact-pinned; CI lint rejects ~= or >=; reproducible lockfile

## Implementation
1. Add to pyproject.toml optional deps:
   [project.optional-dependencies]
   lockfile = ["pip-tools==7.4.1"]
   
2. Generate requirements.lock:
   pip install -e "plugins/dso/scripts[lockfile]"
   pip-compile --generate-hashes plugins/dso/scripts/pyproject.toml \
     --output-file plugins/dso/scripts/requirements.lock

3. Create plugins/dso/scripts/check-lockfile-pins.sh:
   #!/usr/bin/env bash
   # Scan requirements.lock for loose version operators; exit 1 if found
   LOCK="${1:-$(dirname "${BASH_SOURCE[0]}")/requirements.lock}"
   if grep -E '(~=|>=|<=|!=|>|<)[0-9]' "$LOCK"; then
     echo "ERROR: loose pins found in $LOCK" >&2; exit 1
   fi
   echo "OK: all pins in $LOCK are exact"

4. Wire into validate.sh --ci:
   Add to plugins/dso/scripts/validate.sh CI section: bash check-lockfile-pins.sh

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] bash tests/run-all.sh passes
  Verify: bash tests/run-all.sh
- [ ] requirements.lock exists and has SHA256 hashes
  Verify: test -f plugins/dso/scripts/requirements.lock && grep -q "sha256:" plugins/dso/scripts/requirements.lock
- [ ] No loose pins in requirements.lock
  Verify: bash plugins/dso/scripts/check-lockfile-pins.sh plugins/dso/scripts/requirements.lock
- [ ] check-lockfile-pins.sh is executable
  Verify: test -x plugins/dso/scripts/check-lockfile-pins.sh

## Retry Budget
MAX_ATTEMPTS: 3 (sonnet model)
